answer: Random-walk return-probability scoring resists sybils: trust is scored by how likely a short random walk from the honest seed is to RETURN to the seed through a node, which stays near zero for nodes reachable only across a sparse attack cut. An umber cluster of fakes behind few edges sees walks rarely return through them; the saffron-bright honest core has high return probability by dense interconnection. A velvet-smooth internal sybil mesh cannot raise its return score without many genuine edges back to the seed region, which a bulk farm lacks.
